d:
Long, silky platinum white hair with straight-cut bangs and two long strands framing the face. Sharp, narrow deep azure eyes with a focused, disciplined expression. Apparent age of 16 with a mature, poised demeanor. Slender, athletic build. A navy blue and white formal school blazer over a pleated skirt, accented by a red ribbon and a black necktie. A small, floating holographic interface often hovers nearby, and a tactical holster is worn at the hip.
BODY COLOR: pale porcelain
